scope.description: Scalar CPU float64 numerical stability evidence only; no training or promotion.
known_limitations: Convergence cannot establish correctness of the equations or published model fidelity.
The adaptive prototype uses a diagnostic QNM spline with independently generated values and black-box-inferred knot metadata; this is not wholly literature-specified provenance.
Changing dt also changes the adaptive initial step and coarse/fine restart sampling; the grid check measures the complete generator's grid sensitivity.
No time, phase, amplitude, or coefficient fitting is performed.
No derivatives, batched execution, accelerators, or JAX are qualified here.
